original.target_description: Simple linear regression of social media time (SMT; average weekday/weekend hours) on extraversion. Distinct from the adjacent SMEI regression.

notes: Identity verified from supplied full primary-report text: title Investigating the Relationship Between Social Media Use, Big Five Personality, and Well-Being; Ulla Bunz; JoCTEC 2021 4(3), pp. 25–52; DOI 10.51548/joctec-2021-016. Text contains methods, results, discussion and references, not merely an abstract or a preregistration. No PDF was supplied, so no PDF rendering was possible. Only assigned original N and effect fields were evaluated; other fields/sides are placeholders. Same-test p = .002; R2 = .023. Coefficient retained with literal printed beta label; no conversion or unsupported assertion of standardized beta. N=304 is not promoted to analytic N; the target regression reports F(1,417) = 9.98, which is inconsistent with the descriptive total. No N inferred from df. SMT is explicitly distinguished from SMEI by the target description and page locator.
